{{Quote|Paycheck docked. Blast Ko Bas and his blasted purifier!|Personal log of Celis Bol|<ref name="CA" />}}
'''Ko Bas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caarite]], who worked for the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trade alliance during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Bas had responsibility for overseeing operations at a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|secret Cartel base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] dispersed a test batch of a [[Anti-Caarite virus|virus]] fatal to Caarites in the Tilnes facility as part of a plot to weaken the Cartel. Bas survived exposure to the contagion and instead of being [[Death/Legends|killed]] was transformed into a violent, raging [[mutant]] being. Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the release of the virus, a team of Believers ventured to the Cartel base and four of their party were killed and [[Foodstuff/Legends|eaten]] by Bas. Shortly thereafter, a team of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] entered the facility to follow up a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] emanating from the base. Bas attacked the operatives but was defeated by them.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Explosion in south corridor, near Ko Bas's office.|Personal log of Celis Bol|<ref name="CA" />}}
Ko Bas was a [[Caarite]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] for the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trade alliance during latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Bas was responsible for the running of a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|secret base]] operated by the Cartel beneath the surface of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and held the position of [[Overseer of Cartel Operations, Tilnes Special Detachment]]. Bas maintained an office in the base, within which he kept a set of personalized stationary that bore his name.<ref name="CA" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the Cartel [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Celis Bol]] was requested to prepare some [[bean juice]] for Bas. Angered at being given such a menial task, Bol surreptitiously [[Water/Legends|spat]] in the juice that the technician had put together for him. Bas detected the impurities in his juice via a purifier and Bol's pay was docked as punishment.<ref name="CA" />

Four [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the incident with Bol and the bean juice, the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] secretly placed an [[Bomb/Legends|explosive device]] laden with a [[Anti-Caarite virus|virus fatal to Caarites]] within the ventilation system of the Cartel Tilnes base, close to the location of Bas' office. The [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] desired to use their pathogen to weaken the influence of the Caarite-dominated Metatheran Cartel and saw the Tilnes base as a suitable location to test their viral weapon. Bas was in his office when the bomb was detonated and the force of the explosion hurled him against the far side of the room, leaving a blast outline in his shape imprinted against the wall. The virus quickly spread throughout the base, infecting Bas and his colleagues, resulting in the sudden [[Death/Legends|demise]] of the majority of the facility's inhabitants. By a fluke of fate, Bas and two other Caarites, "[[U]]" and "[[G]]," were not killed by the virus and were instead [[Mutant|mutated]] into enlarged violent, raging beings, retaining little semblance of their old selves.<ref name="CA" />

Trapped inside the Cartel facility, Bas and the other two mutants [[Foodstuff/Legends|fed]] off the decaying corpses of the Caarites struck down by the virus. They piled up all of the bodies except those in the front area of the base into a large room at the south side of the facility that had a markedly lower temperature that the rest of the structure, so as to slow the rate of decomposition. The trio largely stuck to the deeper regions of the base and avoided the main entrance to the base. Despite their efforts to preserve the bodies of the deceased Caarites, over the following days the mutants' food supply became increasingly scarce.<ref name="CA" />

Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the dispersal of the anti-Caarite virus, a group of six [[Human/Legends|Human]] Believers ventured to the Metatheran Cartel base on an assignment to survey the results of the release of the contagion. Bas ambushed their party and killed three of the slower members of the group, though the Believers [[Aris (Human)|Aris]] and [[Osia]] fled and escaped from the mutant. Bas then proceeded to consume the corpses of the fallen cultists.<ref name="CA" />

{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]''}}
Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the arrival of the Believers, a team of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] arrived at the Cartel base to investigate a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] sent out from the facility. Just as they entered the base, Bas killed and ate another of the Believers at the far side of the room where he was storing the Caarite cadavers, tossing aside without a thought a [[Silver/Legends|silver]] case carried by the Believer that contained a fresh sample of the anti-Caarite virus. The operatives eventually made their way to Bas' location; the mutant was taken by surprise by their arrival and attacked in a rage but was defeated by them.<ref name="CA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ko Bas asked me to boil bean juice for him today. Is that all I am? A bean juice boiler? I showed him, though&mdash;a little spittle in the bean juice may be just what Ko Bas needs.|Personal log of Celis Bol|<ref name="CA" />}}
Prior to exposure to the anti-Caarite pathogen, Bas was a devious, double-crossing, social-climbing individual. The virus triggered substantial and grotesque physical changes to his body, causing him to grow in stature to 2.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height and the top half of his body to become thick and strong and his [[Limb/Legends|arms]] to be lengthened. He developed [[Claw/Legends|claws]] similar to those of a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]],<ref name="CA" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of predatory [[reptomammal]],<ref name="TNEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> while his head became elongated. His [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] widened, causing his smile to have the appearance of a hungry grin. His transformation left him angry, hungry, and demented, with little [[Brain/Legends|brain]] capacity remaining and beyond all reason. Despite his maddened nature, he retained some affinity for other Caarites and was marginally less hostile to Caarites than to non-Caarites. Bas was of greater physical prowess than the similarly mutated Caarites "U" and "G."<ref name="CA" />

==Talents and abilities==
Bas was proficient in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] and the use of simple [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]]. In addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], he could read and [[Writing/Legends|write]] the [[Language/Legends|languages]] [[Caarimala|Caarite]] and [[Filordian]], though after his transformation following exposure to the anti-Caarite virus he retained an understanding of only Caarite.<ref name="CA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ko Bas was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and appeared in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure released in [[March]] [[2003]] that formed part of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. In the adventure, the player characters role-play as the freelance operatives that encounter Bas in the Cartel base on Tilnes and the choices made by the players can influence Bas' actions and decisions. If the player characters decline to investigate the stricken Cartel base, Bas eventually escapes from the facility and makes his way to a [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] in Tilnes' [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], resulting in loss of life and bringing him into a confrontation with the player characters. The adventure suggests that the players can employ a variety of strategies for fighting Bas, either attacking him directly or combating him from a distance with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] or [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based attacks. It is possible for the player characters to then incapacitate or kill the mutated Caarite.<ref name="CA" />

Bas' level of fighting prowess in his encounter with the freelance agents is dependent upon the roleplaying experience tier of the player characters. If the players are in the lower roleplaying tier, Bas is fatigued, [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] and injured from his fight with the last Believer that he attacked immediately prior to the arrival of the freelance agents, suffering a broken arm. He is too worn down to run at the player characters but hurls rocks and [[Bone/Legends|bones]] and strikes at them if they come to close. If the players are in the middle roleplaying tier, Bas is still fatigued and not capable of running but is not poisoned. If the players at in the upper roleplaying tier, Bas is merely slightly winded from his fight with the Believer and otherwise is in good strength. Bas focuses on attacking the player character who he deems to pose him the greatest threat.<ref name="CA" />
